LESSON: SELECTED CHAPTER SURAH AL- HUJURAT

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an 1.1 Ulum al- Qur’an • The miraculous nature of the Qur’an • Language of t
Topic 1.2: Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What do Muslims learn from Surah al-Hujurat?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read Surah al-Hujurat (Q ) correctly for spiritual nourishment
2. explain the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat for better understanding

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read Surah al-Hujurat (Q ) correctly for spiritual nourishment
   In simple words: practise until you can read Surah al-Hujurat (Q ) correctly for spiritual nourishment. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explain the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat for better understanding
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat for better understanding. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat in the examples.
2. Explain Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat.
4. Show that you can: read Surah al-Hujurat (Q ) correctly for spiritual nourishment

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Surah al-Hujurat (Q 49),
2. Discuss the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat in pairs and make class presentations,
3. Discuss the lessons from Surah al-Hujurat and make notes,
4. Citizenship: the skill of socio-cultural sensitivity and awareness is enhanced as learners research on the teachings of Surah al-Hujurat.
5. Communication and Collaboration: listening and speaking skills are enhanced as learners discuss the lessons from Surah al-Hujurat in groups.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What do Muslims learn from Surah al-Hujurat?
2. How can Muslims use Surah al- Hujurat to enhance peace in the community?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read Surah al-Hujurat (Q ) correctly for spiritual nourishment
2. explain the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat for better understanding

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
